name: Northwest back-of-house block (Market/Seafood/Bakery production + receiving; staff only). 173x330 pt of floor with ZERO fixtures and zero product labels drawn in it, walled off from the sales floor on every side: west/north = the store's exterior wall (boundary x=39, y=77.8), east = the 12.6-pt wall band drawn as fixtures [210.9,115.5,223.5,184.1] and [213.5,192.3,223.3,387.6] whose east face carries the south/east-facing case scallops at x=219-234, y=280-320, south = the wall run at y=408.6 (x=39..82) continued by the wall-thickness rects [82.5,407,121.8,412.9], [124.6,403.7,172.1,415.9], [182.8,404.7,195.7,414.7] and the rounded corner poly [195.6,387.6,223.3,414.8]. The SEAFOOD (156.9,265.4) and BAKERY (169.8,367.5) titles are printed inside this blank block, which is why both fired VERIFY at 100% walkable; the leaks were the staff doors at x=211-223/y=184-192, x=121.8-124.6 and x=172.1-182.8

North back-of-house band behind the back wall (staff only): the sales floor stops at the 13.3-pt wall band drawn as fixtures [222.9,118.3,514.6,131.6], [536.3,118.8,811.6,130.3] and [833.4,119.2,896.7,130.3], whose south face carries the shelf hooks at x=425-515 and the Market/Deli cases; north of it lies a 676x40 pt strip with no fixture and no product label, running from the NW block to the Dairy back block [898.5,76.2,1059,130.3] (already solid). The two breaks in the band at x=514.6-536.3 and x=811.6-833.4 are jamb-drawn service doorways — they are what leaked the strip onto the sales floor and are sealed with it. The MARKET/DELI title (641.9,103.9) is printed in this strip, hence its VERIFY; DAIRY (963.2,105.3) is printed on the back block itself and snaps forward to its case frontage

Deli/Market production room behind the deli block (staff only): a 81x228 pt walled room with nothing drawn inside it — west wall [339.4,170.9,350.9,371.1], north wall [339.4,159.6,410.7,170.9], east wall [431.9,166.2,444.1,566.1], south wall [356.8,399.1,431.9,411.5] plus the corner pieces [342.2,380.5,356.5,396.7] and poly [342.2,397.4,356.8,411.5].
